pages.text: An airtight chest seal on an open chest wound.
A needle for tension pneumothorax — releases air. Medicine 3.

Open pneumothorax: hard to breathe, SpO₂ falls. Seal it — in $(cfg)2–4$() min the lung holds.$(br2)$(l)Tension$() pneumothorax: pressure drops, cardiac arrest in $(cfg)3$() min. Only the needle helps, then a chest drain in the OR.
